description.value: The elementals know that the Vanu Vanu are more susceptible to attacks from foreign races and monster and grant them their wind ability. Once per day, as a swift action, a vanu can grant himself a +2 deflection bonus to AC against ranged attacks for 1 minute.

effect: Swift; +2 deflection AC against ranged attacks only for one minute.

description.value: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks, and they learn one additional language every time they put a rank in the Linguistics skill.

contextNotes.text: Bluff and Diplomacy include the racial bonus. Each Linguistics rank grants an additional language.

description.value: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls, a +2 dodge bonus to AC, and a +2 bonus on Perception checks against flying creatures. In addition, enemies on higher ground gain no attack roll bonus against vanu.
Against ranged attacks only; does not increase melee AC.
Only against a flying opponent.

contextNotes.text: An opponent gets no attack bonus for higher ground.
